labels.io.gravitee.description: Sets up the playground in API Management
labels.io.gravitee.name: Playground seed

files.compose.yml:
x-gravitee: {kind: playground, name: Clean playground, category: Other, description: A playground whose seed is the Lab's own}
services:
  hostile-clean-app:
    image: busybox:1.36
    ports: ["127.0.0.1:8396:80"]
    environment:
      HOSTILE_LOGIN: demo
  hostile-clean-seed:
    image: hostile-seeder
    build: ../../../../../seeder
    pull_policy: build
    restart: "no"
    labels:
      io.gravitee.role: seed
      io.gravitee.name: Playground seed
      io.gravitee.description: Sets up the playground in API Management
    depends_on:
      apim-management-api:
        condition: service_healthy
    volumes:
      - ./seed:/seed:ro
      - ./.state:/state
    environment:
      APIM_MANAGEMENT_URL: http://apim-management-api:8083
      APIM_GATEWAY_URL: http://localhost:8082
      HOSTILE_DEMO_PASSWORD: ${HOSTILE_DEMO_PASSWORD:-demo}

meta.description: A playground whose seed is the Lab's own
meta.name: Clean playground
